features.name: Conversation Model
acceptance_criteria: Stable conversation identifier and timestamps exist.
Messages record role, content and timestamp.

features.name: Conversation Repository
acceptance_criteria: SQLite supports create, append and retrieve.

features.name: Conversation Context Reconstruction
acceptance_criteria: Later requests can access relevant prior context.

features.name: Source-of-Truth Protection
acceptance_criteria: Conversation cannot override StoreClient facts or approved policy.

features.name: Persistence Failure Handling
acceptance_criteria: Failures do not create fabricated history.

features.name: Phase 1-5 Regression Coverage
acceptance_criteria: Existing retrieval, order, eligibility and escalation behaviour remains intact.
